title: Beyond Skinwalker investigation at Bradshaw Ranch

tellings.quote: I went there myself and there were some strange things that came up on the cameras.

plain: Strange things are said to have shown up on cameras at Bradshaw Ranch near Sedona, Arizona, during an investigation called Beyond Skinwalker, named after Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of odd events. The teller, a guest on Michels's episode with the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, says firsthand: "I went there myself and there were some strange things that came up on the cameras," and names a Dr. Taylor and a witness named Erik Bard as part of the story.
